significance: A wooden temple in the deodar forest of Dhungri, Manali, raised over the cave where the goddess is said to have meditated. It is the focus of the town's spring fair and of Navaratri worship, and is prized for its carved timber doorway and tiered roofs.
story: Hidimbi married the Pandava Bhima after he killed her brother Hidimb, and their son was the giant Ghatotkacha.
